name: Bralyx Reminders
author: Bralyx
description: Reminders in your Omarchy bar — set a time, get a desktop notification, then snooze, edit, or delete from the pill. Fully local (systemd user timers), no account and no network.

barWidget.description: Bar bell with active count. Open the panel to create, snooze, edit, or delete local desktop reminders.
